title: Better Media Player
no_rooms: No rooms yet: add one (left, Add room).
routes.label: Show route:
nav_hint: Drag empty space: pan · wheel: scroll · Ctrl + wheel: zoom · drag a device to move it · Del: remove what is picked
route.pick: Pick a source above to see what happens when it starts.
insp.click: Click a device or a cable to see how it is set up.
insp.fallback: If CEC has not after {timeout} s, BMP switches it itself
settings.behaviour_hint: The room's settings; its devices' (wait, standby, off at night) are in their details under Devices & cabling.
settings.not_loaded: The room is not loaded: its settings are not shown.
central.missing: The central entry is not set up: follow me and the dashboard settings are off.
setting.night_idle_timeout: Night: off when nothing plays for
setting.off_wait: Wait before the plug goes off
insp.volume_migrated: Taken over from v1.2.0: the room volume was set on {entity}, which belongs to no device of the room. It is now the volume of the {device} (rooms without speakers: the display's). If it belongs to another device, give that device the volume and use it as the room's volume.
add.title: Add to the room
add.player_video: A video player (e.g. Kodi): needs picture and sound
add.player_audio: A music player (e.g. a Music Assistant player): needs sound
add.kind_receiver: AV receiver or soundbar: sound, often inputs and a volume
add.kind_speakers: Active speakers (on a plug or switching themselves)
add.kind_switch: HDMI switch or matrix: chooses inputs
add.kind_mixer: Passive: several sources mixed, nothing switched
add.kind_splitter: Passive: one source to several devices, nothing switched
add.kind_passive_speakers: No power of their own: driven by a receiver or amplifier
cable.armed: New cable: click the device it plugs into (Esc: cancel).
central.follow_hint: A Music Assistant group player with dynamic members; empty: no follow me.
delete.title: Delete {room}?
delete.text: The room goes at once (not with Save): its room player, its controls and its device in Home Assistant disappear; automations and dashboards that use them no longer work. Its devices are not touched – what is on stays on.
delete.new: The room has not been saved yet: it is simply dropped.
delete.others_kept: The room is deleted; the other rooms' unsaved changes are kept.
form.unknown_entity: Not known to Home Assistant (right now): {entities}
insp.name: Name
insp.id_new: Fixed once saved: automations use it (or the name), e.g. set_setting with device: {id}.
insp.id_fixed: Fixed: automations use it (or the name).
insp.passive_hint: Driven by what feeds it: not switched, on whenever that is on.
insp.passive_mixer: Passive: several sources mixed, nothing switched, no input to choose.
insp.passive_splitter: Passive: what goes in goes to every output – everything behind it comes on for the source.
insp.devices_hint: A media player or remote that turns the device on and off (after its plug, if any).
insp.own_actions: Own actions to switch it (e.g. IR scripts)
insp.sensors_hint: Power sensors: for waiting for standby before the plug goes off.
insp.host_hint: E.g. the box the player runs on: on before the player is woken, off after it (once it has shut down).
insp.inputs_hint: The media player or remote that chooses the device's input (its source list).
insp.input_actions_hint: An action per input (e.g. an IR script), when the device has no source list.
insp.volume_hint: A media player with a volume, or a number – e.g. an amplifier's level.
insp.is_room_volume: Presets, night limit and follow me set the room's volume here.
insp.input_hint: The input the device is switched to for this cable (from its list, or as written).
insp.input_none_hint: The device has no input choice yet: set it up in its details (Inputs via).
insp.mode_cec: HDMI-CEC switches the input (e.g. the player wakes the TV on its input); BMP only waits for it.
insp.mode_never: Nobody switches it: the input is only described.
insp.insert_hint: Splits the cable and puts a passive device in between.
onoff.label: Switched on and off by
onoff.auto_player: Automatic: the player itself – it offers on / off (e.g. Kodi's Wake-on-LAN).
onoff.auto_actions: Automatic: its own actions – it offers no on / off.
onoff.auto_nothing: Automatic: nothing – it offers no on / off, and there are no own actions.
onoff.player: turn on / turn off of the player (e.g. Kodi's Wake-on-LAN).
onoff.player_cannot: This player offers no on / off – nothing would happen; choose actions or none.
onoff.actions: Own actions: a script or button each for on and off.
onoff.none: None: the room never switches the player itself; it only wakes it by playing.
save.label: Saving
save.idle: Changes here apply with Save; settings can also be set with the action better_media_player.set_setting.
save.restart: {room} is playing: saving its setup restarts the room – what is on stays on, playback goes on.
save.refused: {room} was not saved: see its problems.
save.changed: {room} was changed meanwhile (in another window): it and the rooms after it were not saved. Discard to see it as it is now.
settings.name: Name
settings.volume_hint: One volume for the room – on the players, or on a device of the room that has a volume.
settings.volume_none: No device of the room has a volume yet: give one its volume in its details (Devices & cabling).
settings.follow_hint: With presence sensors the room takes part in follow me: when someone is here, the music comes here. Several sensors: one is enough.
settings.idle_hint: Nothing plays – paused, stopped, at the end of the list, in a menu – for this long: the room goes off (sound devices first, then the player, then the picture). A player you turn off yourself: everything goes off at once.
problem.no_player: The room has no player yet – add one (Add → Players).
problem.two_players_of_a_kind: Only one video and one music player per room.
problem.same_player: Video and music player must be different ({entity}).
problem.group_player: {entity} is a group player: choose the room's own player.
problem.room_player: {entity} is a room of Better Media Player: it cannot be used here.
problem.needs_actions: {source}: choose its on and/or off action.
problem.player_no_onoff: {entity} offers no on / off: nothing happens when the room switches it.
problem.bad_id: “{device}” is no valid ID (small letters, digits and _, starting with a letter).
problem.needs_both_actions: {device}: choose both the on and the off action.
problem.device_is_player: {device}: {entity} is one of the room's players.
problem.used_twice: {entity} is switched twice in this room.
problem.volume_device_missing: The room's volume is on a device that has no volume: choose one.
problem.volume_is_player: {entity} is a player of the room: it cannot be a device's volume.
problem.player_no_volume: {entity} cannot set a volume: the room volume does not work for it.
problem.cable_end_missing: A cable leads to something the room no longer has.
problem.cycle: The cabling goes round in a circle.
problem.input_conflict: {source} would need two different inputs on {device}.
problem.no_inputs: {device} cannot choose inputs (“{input}”): set up its inputs.
problem.off_route: {device} is on no player's way: nothing switches it.
problem.follow_not_group: {entity} is no Music Assistant group player.
problem.nothing_switches: {device}: choose its plug, the device that switches itself or its own actions – or make it passive.
insp.id_taken: The ID {id} is taken or reserved.
over.title: Cabling not described yet
over.text: Players and devices are here (a room set up with v1.2.0 is taken over like this). Until cables are described, the room works as before: the players feed the devices directly (dotted lines) – the picture to the display, the sound to speakers, subwoofer, receiver and amplifier.
over.passive: Taken over as cables, the room keeps working the same. From there, insert mixers or splitters, or let BMP choose inputs.
over.volume: Room volume: it was set on {entity}, which belongs to no device of the room; it is now the volume of {device}. If it belongs to another device, give that device the volume and use it as the room's volume.
over.button: Take over the dotted lines as cables
over.after: An unsaved change: check it, then Save (or Discard).
over.cable: A new cable: click the dot on the right of a tile, then the tile it plugs into.
over.move: Drag a tile to move it; the arrangement changes nothing in how the room works.
live.switch_hint: Live: what the room does right now (remembered in this browser)
live.held: left off until the next start
live.not_loaded: The room is not loaded: nothing to show live.
live.s_starting: {source} starting · devices are switched on, then the player is woken
live.s_starting_cec: {source} starting · waiting for {device} to come on over CEC ({left} s left, then BMP switches it itself)
live.s_failed: Start failed: {error}. What the start switched on is off again.
live.s_manual: Switched by hand: automatic switching waits until everything is off.
live.s_no_auto: Automatic power is off: the room switches nothing by itself.
live.s_by_hand: {device}'s input was changed by hand to {input}: left so until the next source starts.
live.s_going_off: {source}: nothing played for {min} min · the sound is off, {player} goes off, then the picture
live.s_kept_on: Kept on · nothing goes off by itself until you release it or press All off
live.s_holding: {source} {word} since {since} · nothing plays: the room goes off {off} – the sound first, then {player}. Playing again keeps it on
live.s_holding_picture: {source} {word} since {since} · nothing plays: the room goes off {off} – the sound first, then {player}, then the picture. Playing again keeps it on
live.s_holding_ever: {source} {word} since {since} · no idle timeout: it stays on
live.s_going_off_some: Devices are going off (waiting for their standby or for the player to shut down)
live.paused_unsaved: Live paused: this room has unsaved changes to its setup – the drawing shows them, not what runs. Save or discard to see it live.
live.why_hold: needed: {source} does not play – until its idle timeout ends
live.why_prewarm: needed: follow me prewarms the speakers
live.why_restart: after a restart: waits for {player} to report
live.why_kept: not needed: the room is kept on
live.s_starting_cec_only: {source} starting · waiting for {device} to come on over CEC ({left} s left; without it, it stays off until the next start)
live.s_starting_auto: Starting · the devices are switched on
live.s_playing_all: {source} playing on {player} · every device on, every input chosen
live.s_going_off_at: Devices go off {off} (waiting for their standby or for a player to shut down)
live.r_restart: a player that has not reported since the restart
live.r_hold: a player that does not play
